title: Closure under signed variable identification
statement: Let $B$ assign to each dimension $k$ a class of functions from the $k$-dimensional sign cube to ${-1,1}$. Suppose $B$ is closed under independently negating input coordinates and under identifying input coordinates. Then for every $f\in B_n$, every sign vector $z\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and every map $\pi:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$, the function $w\mapsto f\bigl((z_iw_{\pi(i)})_{i=1}^n\bigr)$ belongs to $B_m$.
hypotheses_covered: z is an n-dimensional sign vector
π maps the n input coordinates to m coordinates
